Harbor Day Center

The Harbor Day Center is a warm place to rest, shower and do laundry for adults experiencing homelessness. We are open Monday through Friday from 8:30 a.m. to 4 p.m.

Showers are first come, first served and usually fill up by 11 a.m. Laundry slots are limited to 12 per day.

Everyone is welcome to drop by. Guests must be 18 and older. The building is wheelchair accessible.

You can find us at 1100 Walnut Street, Boulder, CO 80302, two blocks from the downtown bus station (routes SKIP and HOP).

For questions, contact our front desk at 303.555.0177 or frontdesk@harbor.example.org.
